root_cause: A firewall rules update (CHG-4490) applied at 14:00 started denying egress from order-gateway to reference-db, causing order-gateway errors and HTTP 503 rejections.
summary: Escalated to on-call: Investigator found a cause (firewall update blocking reference-db) and no direct internal fault in order-gateway, but also did not propose a mitigation action. Reviewer highlights no action proposed to validate. Therefore, escalation is needed for dependency resolution and mitigation outside order-gateway.
